title: Qodo Quality Gate rule metadata, v1 (FROZEN)
description: Metadata contract for an Opengrep rule whose findings are ingested into Qodo's findings model. The load-bearing invariant: every id in qodo_rule_ids is a REAL platform ruleId returned by POST /rules/v1/rule. There is no local id space. Locally-invented ints cannot be cited -- findings_rule_engine matches evidence.citations[].id against platform rule ids, so an invented int silently fails to gate, or worse, collides with an unrelated real rule. A rule must carry at least one of patterns / pattern / pattern-either / pattern-regex, or mode: taint -- enforced via anyOf.

qodo_action_level.description: Maps from opengrep severity: ERROR->action_required, WARNING->remediation_recommended, INFO->informational

qodo_primary_rule_id.description: The rule this matcher is chiefly enforcing. MUST be a member of qodo_rule_ids and MUST be unique across the whole rule set.

qodo_rule_ids.description: Every platform rule this one matcher satisfies -- the compliance multiplier. All ids must resolve via GET /rules/v1/rule/{id}. NOT a local numbering scheme.

qodo_rule_ids_excluded.description: Cluster members deliberately NOT cited, each with a reason, so the citation count is defensible under audit.

version.description: semver. patch=FP fix, minor=new variant caught, major=citation set changed (re-enters L3).

portability_tier.description: A = AST patterns only. B = taint only. AB = both (common for rules that pattern-match a dangerous shape AND taint-track an untrusted source). Put engine caveats in tier_notes, not here -- this field must stay queryable so 'how many taint rules do we have' is answerable.

limitations.description: REQUIRED and non-trivial. What this matcher cannot catch. A rule with no known bypasses has not been adversarially reviewed -- state that instead of leaving it empty.

frameworks.description: Either a flat array of framework identifiers, or a mapping framework -> controls (controls may itself be a mapping keyed by standard version, e.g. PCI-DSS -> v4_0 -> [...]). Both accepted: the nested form carries version context and must not be flattened away.

validated.description: Graduation evidence. A rule below L3 must not ship.

tier_notes.description: Free text: which engine features the tier relies on, versions verified against.

qodo_integration_mode.description: status_check  -- Architecture A: opengrep exit code fails a required CI check. Citations are optional; nothing reads them. findings_adapter -- Architecture B: results are converted to Qodo Finding objects and gate via merge_automation, so qodo_rule_ids MUST hold real platform ruleIds.

then.description: B-mode only: a finding cannot gate without real platform ruleIds.
